blog_title: Polo T-Shirt Collar Types: Interlock vs Rib Collar — Why 300 Pcs Worth ₹50K Got Rejected
caption:
₹50k batch rejected after 2 washes. Collars completely flat. 😬

A printer ordered 300 pieces of 220 GSM polos, printed them, delivered to clients — then the collars collapsed. We learned the difference the hard way: interlock collars have zero elasticity, rib collars bounce back every wash.

Interlock = flat. Rib = elastic. Always pick rib.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
